name: Nick Brown
stance: Wants Congress to regulate frontier AI to keep it under human control, and opposes federal preemption of state AI laws.

statements.text: Lawmakers must act to protect the public's interest and ensure safe AI development. Inaction will lead to potentially existential risks.
But we need bipartisan leadership from Congress to prevent the technology from ever evading human control and infringing on our rights.
At the pace technology and AI moves, limiting state laws and regulations for 10 years is dangerous.
Joined a 36-AG letter to Congress opposing federal legislation that would bar states from enacting or enforcing AI laws.
